title: African American Cancer Prevention Project: Establishing a Cohort to Investigate Health Disparities
brief_summary: The goal of this research study is to learn if certain factors may affect cancer rates among African Americans. These factors include behavioral, social, and environmental factors including diet and physical activity, cigarette smoking, cancer screening, health care, neighborhood environment, and mental health.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. be age 18 years old and above
2. read and write English
3. live in the Houston metro area
4. have a viable (working) telephone number and home address

Exclusion Criteria:

1\) None.
study_population: Adult attendees of Windsor Village United Methodist Church living in Houston.
